statements.sql: select "formations".*, "employee_formation"."employee_id" as "pivot_employee_id", "employee_formation"."formation_id" as "pivot_formation_id" from "formations" inner join "employee_formation" on "formations"."id" = "employee_formation"."formation_id" where "employee_formation"."employee_id" in (24)
select * from "contracts" where "contracts"."employee_id" in (24) order by "startDate" asc
